units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 42a:10">Snh. 42ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>ולרוזנים</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 31:4">Prov. XXXI, 4</cite>) <he>העוסקים ברָזוֹ של עולם וכ׳</he> those engaged in the foundation of the world (administration of justice) must abstain from strong drink.

senses.gloss: (corresp. to סוֹד) secret. Ib. 94ᵃ (ref. to Is. XXIV, 16) אמר שר העולם … רָזִי לי רזי לי the genius of the world said, Master of the world, do the will of this righteous man (Ezekiel) (make him the Messiah); then a divine voice went forth saying, my secret is mine &c. (v. Targ. a. Vulgate Is. l. c.).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 88a:8">Sabb. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>מי גילה לבני רז זה וכ׳</he> who revealed to my children this secret by which the ministering angels are guided?; a. e.—Pl. <he>רָזִים</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 70b:5">Snh. 70ᵇ</cite> (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>מי שכל רָזֵי עולם גלוים וכ׳</he> should he to whom all secrets of the world are revealed, drink wine and be drunk?; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 1; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1">Num. R. s. 10<sup>4</sup></cite>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:11">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> <he>גליתי רָזֵיהֶם וכ׳</he> I revealed their (the angels’) secret to the sons of man; a. e.—[Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᶜ bot., read as <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:10:2">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>בארזים</he>, v. <cite ref="A03056"><he>אֲרָזִין</he></cite>.]
